# Native record captures

The Claude and Codex usage captures and the observed model and effort captures were extracted on 2026-10-15 from existing local CLI session records; no model call was made to produce these fixtures. The two Grok Build 1.0.62 context captures were added later, shaped after a real session's records, and the values in `context_grok_1.0.62_signals.json` were set by hand to agree with the updates capture.

| Capture | Native source and version | Retained fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `usage_claude_2.1.296.jsonl` | Claude Code 2.1.296, version recorded on the original transcript entries | Five assistant content-block records with two message IDs and their complete native usage objects. IDs are replaced consistently. |
| `usage_codex_0.162.1.jsonl` | Codex 0.162.1, version in the rollout session metadata and installed `codex --version` | One `event_msg` / `token_count` with its complete `info` object. |
| `context_grok_1.0.62_updates.jsonl` | Grok Build 1.0.62, installed binary; shapes taken from a real session's `updates.jsonl` | Eight lines in order: streamed updates with `_meta.totalTokens` (3,187, 3,187, 81,406, 205,620), `auto_compact_started`, `auto_compact_completed` (`tokens_before` 205,620, `tokens_after` 25,032), a trailing update that still repeats 205,620, then one with 25,500. Message text is replaced by an ellipsis; session id and event ids are replaced. |
| `context_grok_1.0.62_signals.json` | Grok Build 1.0.62, installed binary and a real session's `signals.json` | Only the counters about compaction and the context (`compactionCount`, `totalTokensBeforeCompaction`, `contextWindowUsage`, `contextTokensUsed`, `contextWindowTokens`) and `turnCount`, with values set to agree with the updates capture. |
| `observed_claude.jsonl` | Claude Code 2.1.296 and 2.1.302, version on the original entries; installed `claude` is 2.1.302 | Four assistant records cut from real transcripts, in order: a main-transcript turn (2.1.296, `claude-opus-5`, effort `high`), a later main-transcript turn (2.1.302, `claude-opus-5-5`, `medium`), a sidechain turn from a `subagents/agent-*.jsonl` (2.1.302, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `high`) and a main-transcript `<synthetic>` notice (2.1.302, no effort). Only `type`, `isSidechain`, `message.id` (replaced), `message.model`, the complete native `message.usage`, the top-level `effort` and `version` are kept. |
| `observed_codex_0.162.1.jsonl` | Codex 0.162.1, `cli_version` in the rollout session metadata and installed `codex --version` | Two `turn_context` records from two rollouts (`gpt-6.1-sol` with effort `medium`, then `codex-auto-review` with `low`); only `type`, `payload.model` and `payload.effort` are kept. |
| `observed_codex_unset_effort_0.162.1.jsonl` | Codex 0.162.1, `cli_version` in the rollout session metadata and installed `codex --version`; captured 2026-10-20 | One `turn_context` record of a session whose configuration set no reasoning effort: Codex leaves the `effort` key out. Only `type` and `payload.model` remain. |
| `codex_models_cache_0.162.1.json` | Codex 0.162.1, the catalogue cache's own `client_version`; read from an account's `models_cache.json` on 2026-10-20 | `fetched_at`, `client_version` and three of the account's `models` entries (two listed, one hidden), each cut to `slug`, `display_name`, `default_reasoning_level`, the `effort` of each `supported_reasoning_levels` element and `visibility`. `identity`, `etag` and every other entry field are dropped. |

The Grok model and effort replay through the existing `titles_grok_1.0.60_summary.json` capture (`current_model_id`, `reasoning_effort`).

Transcript content, file paths, session/request identities, timestamps and unrelated record metadata were omitted from the JSONL captures. Token values and nested usage structures of the Claude and Codex captures are unchanged. When `usage_claude_2.1.296.jsonl` was captured, the latest available Claude transcript was produced by 2.1.296; the installed executable had since advanced to 2.1.300, which was not run against a model to create a new capture.

The context size is read from these as follows. Claude repeats the same final per-message usage in multiple content-block records; the size is the last line's input (`input_tokens` plus cache creation plus cache read, output left out), so the capture gives 48,762 for the first message and 52,051 for the second. Codex's `token_count` gives the last request's `last_token_usage.total_tokens` and the `model_context_window` (18,829 of 475,000). The existing `rollout_running_turn.jsonl` capture is replayed as a native near-miss: `token_count` with `info: null` reports no known context. The Grok captures replay to 25,500 tokens in a 256,000 window: the compaction gives 25,032, and the update repeating 205,620 after it is skipped.
